xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex4022024-09-1315-25-43" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4132"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4134">rje klong rdol bla ma</rs>'i drung yig</rs> 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad nas ngal ba chen pos lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas || bstan bcos 'di nyid la sogs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i phung po che chung ji snyed cig byas pa thams cad ma gyur nam [120b3] mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la || byams pa dang snying rje'i rtsa ba can gyis byang chub kyi sems rin po che myur du rgyud la skye ba'i rgyur 'gro bar gyur cig || dge ba de dag kyang sems can thams cad kyi <abbr>dug gsum</abbr> 'phel ba'i rgyu dang [120b4] sdig pa bsags pa'i rgyu la mi 'gro bar shogs shig ||</seg></TEI>
